column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key for the beneficiary or assessment record (e.g., 'BENE0001').
A VARCHAR(20) referencing DisasterEvents(DistRegistry), connecting beneficiaries to an event (e.g., 'DIST0001').
A VARCHAR(20) referencing Operations(OpsRegistry), linking to the ongoing operations (e.g., 'OPS0001').
An enum (BeneRegister_enum) describing beneficiary registration; values: 'Complete', 'Pending', 'Partial'.
An enum (VulnerabilityReview_enum) indicating vulnerability assessment; values: 'Complete', 'Pending', 'In Progress'.
An enum (NeedsAssessStatus_enum) capturing needs assessment status; values: 'Due', 'Overdue', 'Updated'.
A DECIMAL(5,2) for distribution equity index (e.g., 0.85).
An enum (CommEngageLvl_enum) describing community engagement; values: 'High', 'Low', 'Medium'.
An enum (LocalCapacityGrowth_enum) tracking local capacity building; values: 'Limited', 'Active'.
